title: Reality Check Gate
summary: The NEXUS final gate: the Reality Checker assesses the integrated result against the spec (default NEEDS_WORK), a fixer addresses what it found, and the check repeats — at most 3 checks before the verdict stands.

spec.description: What was supposed to be delivered

nodes.verdict_guide: READY = every core requirement evidenced, no critical issues. NEEDS_WORK = list each gap as a numbered, fixable item.

nodes.task: Fix every numbered gap from the reality check. Fix only those items. Report what you changed and how each gap is now closed, with evidence.
